subject: Quick check: approval cadence & funding window for FinOpsCo
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finopsco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today’s discovery call

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking time to run through your stack and short-term goals this morning. Quick recap so we’re aligned: 

- Primary goal: Reduce per-token inference cost for customer-facing recommendations and bring latency under 150ms p95 for 512-token requests.
- Current constraints: procurement requires signed SOW + SOC2 evidence; infra team prefers VPC deployment for PII workflows.
- Success criteria for Q3 pilot: consistent 150ms p95, estimated 40% cost reduction vs current hosted endpoint, and turnaround for a 6-week pilot.

What I’m doing next: Ben and I will assemble a short MVP pricing sheet and a mutual action plan showing milestones, owners, and an expected procurement checklist. I’ll share those by Thursday.

Could you confirm two things for us so we can lock the schedule?
1) Is July 31 still the target date you mentioned for a budget/approval decision at your leadership meeting?
2) Who on your side needs to be looped into the SOC2 evidence package (email addresses are fine)?

Thanks — appreciate the clarity as we try to align the pilot window with your end-of-quarter review.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood-mvp-pricing-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan-FinOpsCo.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Sam Walker <sam.walker@finopsco.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing + MAP (attached) — items for procurement

Sam —

Attached is the lightweight pricing sheet and mutual action plan Rachel promised. A few notes:

- Pricing assumes a 6-week pilot: reserved batch capacity for peak traffic + a small burst pool. We included both hosted and VPC cost lines so procurement can compare.
- SOC2 + architecture diagram folder link is in the MAP (bottom of the first tab).
- Suggested SOW language for the pilot is in the "scope" tab — feel free to redline.

If procurement wants a vendor security call, we can schedule one next week (30-minute slot).

Rachel — did you get confirmation on the July 31 leadership window? Ben and I want to make sure we present pricing that matches their expected commitment size.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-mvp-pricing-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan-FinOpsCo.xlsx

From: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finopsco.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finopsco.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing + MAP (attached) — items for procurement

Rachel —

Appreciate the fast follow-up and the MAP. A couple of items from my side:

- Leadership pushed the budget discussion out to next week — July 31 is now a soft target; final approval likely the week of Aug 4 depending on a small reallocation request.
- Procurement wants to see the vendor security packet and a short list of references (three customers running private/VPC deployments). Can you provide those by end of day Wednesday?
- Also can you confirm onboarding lead time if we sign the SOW on Aug 7 — what's realistic for a pilot go-live?

I’ll route the MAP to procurement now. If there’s a way to compress the approval window (e.g., an early start on dev onboarding while contracts finish), let me know — could speed things up.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Walker | Head of Platform Engineering
FinOpsCo
sam.walker@finopsco.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finopsco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procurement@finopsco.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing + MAP (attached) — items for procurement

Thanks Sam — that timeline note is super helpful. Quick answers and a small ask: 

- References & security packet: Ben and I will send a consolidated link with three VPC customers + a vendor security zip by EOD Wednesday (28 Jul).
- Onboarding lead time: If SOW signed Aug 7, realistic pilot go-live is Aug 25–29 assuming we get access to a staging VPC by Aug 11. We can run parallel onboarding tasks (agent onboarding, prompt migration) to shorten that by ~1 week if you authorize an early access agreement.
- Small ask: can you confirm whether the leadership review is purely budgetary or if there’s a separate technical sign-off that needs to happen before procurement issues the PO? That will help us prioritize the reference decks vs. a short technical workshop.

If helpful, Ben and I can do a 20-minute technical executive briefing with your CTO and Head of Infra mid-week to keep momentum.

Appreciate it — aiming to keep this in the final-week window if we can.

Best,
Rachel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
